people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: After the piece of bread, then Satan entered into him. Then Jesus said to him, “What you do, do quickly.”
translations.bsb: And when Judas had taken the morsel, Satan entered into him. Then Jesus said to Judas, “What you are about to do, do quickly.”
translations.kjv: And after the sop Satan entered into him. Then said Jesus unto him, That thou doest, do quickly.
translations.asv: And after the sop, then entered Satan into him. Jesus therefore saith unto him, What thou doest, do quickly.
